countries.name: Germany
countries.gap: The 1948 reform had several rates, so no single factor is exact for Reichsmark amounts; West Germany only, and the Saarland and East Germany are not covered.

source.title: Deutsche Bundesbank, "The economic and currency reform of 1948: the basis for stable money" (wages and rents converted 1:1; balances at less than 1:10; 60 RM exchanged for 40 DM per head)

steps.note: No single rate existed: wages, salaries and rents converted 1:1, each person swapped 60 RM for 40 DM (then 20 more), and bank balances converted at less than 1:10. The conventional 10:1 is used here.
